status: frozen analytical candidate; product agreement and independent scrutiny recorded separately

execution/PKG-04/DEL-04-07/Work/pressure-contract.md 'Constant-effort combinations: the unit factor-sum rule'; 'Tees and pressure junctions' (D-1)
independence: standard library only; no product code, product output, fixture or generated envelope is imported, read or run; all data invented

model.theory: small-displacement linear elastic straight circular pipe members; nodal loads only; anchors restrain all six DOFs
model.constant_effort: consumed iff exactly one declared translational restraint DOF and constant_load > 0; then a constant nodal force of constant_load along the POSITIVE global axis of that DOF in every solved case/state, zero stiffness, no restraint row; otherwise not consumed (no force, no restraint)
model.pressure: caps -p*A_i*s at every transfers_to_wall terminal (s from the node into the member); Poisson pair as the axial eigenstrain -2*nu*p*A_i/(E*A_n); N_w = statics wall force; S = N_w - p*A_i
model.thermal: axial eigenstrain alpha*dT on the nominal section (E*A_n*alpha*dT held force)
model.d5: nominal wall for A, I, J and the Timoshenko shear area; A_i = pi*r_i,r^2 for caps and the Poisson pair; per basis b: sigma = N_w/A_b, bending |M_perp|/Z_b, torsion |T|*r_o/J_b; Lame of each basis's own annulus
model.timoshenko: phi = 12*E*I_n/(G*kappa_E*A_n*L^2); kappa_E exact rational of section-bases §3.1 on the nominal section; rotations are section rotations

formulations.A: force method on the released tree: root anchor kept, other anchors released into six redundants; statics resultants; unit-load integrals int nN/EA + m.M/EI + tT/GJ (+ v.V/(kappa G A)) + n*eps0, exact Simpson
formulations.B: assembled 3-D frame stiffness (EB or Timoshenko 12x12, exact direction cosines), caps and constant force as nodal loads, eigenstrains as held end actions, Gauss-Jordan over Fractions per power of pi, R = K u - f

conventions.global_axes: Z is vertical (up); a weight W acts along -Z
conventions.reaction: force/moment the anchor exerts on the pipe (R = K u - f), global axes
conventions.member_end_action: force/moment the node exerts on the member at that end, global axes; axial part at the far end is +N_w
conventions.stress_stations: member ends (moment is linear along every member: nodal loads only)
conventions.combinations: linear quantities only (motions, reactions, end actions, N_w, N_w/A_b); magnitudes and maxima of combinations are not published

model.exact_form: sum of q*pi^k (q rational) or sqrt(q)*pi^k terms; 'value' is the nearest binary64, decided by rational pi bounds 1e-110 apart
